templates.name: activities_per_publisher
templates.description: Number of distinct activities per publisher, optionally restricted to activities whose start date (start_actual, else start_planned; stored as Activity.start_date) falls in [start_from, start_to). Omits publishers with zero matches.
templates.cypher:
MATCH (a:Activity)
WHERE ($publisher IS NULL OR a.publisher = $publisher)
  AND ($start_from IS NULL OR a.start_date >= date($start_from))
  AND ($start_to IS NULL OR a.start_date < date($start_to))
RETURN a.publisher AS key, count(DISTINCT a.iati_identifier) AS value, collect(DISTINCT a.source_id) AS evidence
ORDER BY key
templates.coverage: Counts retained activities in the snapshot only; the hunger filter decides what is retained.

templates.name: activities_per_publisher_by_country

RETURN a.publisher AS key, count(DISTINCT a.iati_identifier) AS value,
       reduce(acc = [], l IN collect(DISTINCT r.source_ids) | acc + coalesce(l, [])) + collect(DISTINCT a.source_id) AS evidence
ORDER BY key
templates.coverage: An activity targeting several countries is counted once per country; percentages are ignored.

templates.name: latest_update_per_publisher
templates.description: Latest publisher-reported last_updated calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) per publisher.

WITH a.publisher AS key, max(a.last_updated) AS latest, collect(DISTINCT a.source_id) AS evidence

ORDER BY key

templates.name: activities_per_sdg
templates.description: Number of distinct activities linked to each SDG key (e.g. '2:2').

RETURN s.sdg_key AS key, count(DISTINCT a.iati_identifier) AS value, reduce(acc = [], l IN collect(DISTINCT r.source_ids) | acc + coalesce(l, [])) AS evidence

templates.name: participants_by_role
templates.description: Number of distinct organisation refs occurring in each participation role code ('1' funding, '2' accountable, '3' extending, '4' implementing). Repeated rows do not increase counts.
templates.cypher:
MATCH (o:Organisation)-[p:PARTICIPATES_IN]->(:Activity)
RETURN p.role AS key, count(DISTINCT o.ref) AS value, reduce(acc = [], l IN collect(DISTINCT p.source_ids) | acc + coalesce(l, [])) AS evidence
ORDER BY key
templates.coverage: Role codes follow the IATI OrganisationRole codelist.

templates.name: multi_publisher_participants
templates.description: Organisation refs that participate in activities of at least min_publishers distinct publishers, with the number of distinct activities each participates in.
templates.cypher:
MATCH (o:Organisation)-[p:PARTICIPATES_IN]->(a:Activity)
WITH o, collect(DISTINCT a.publisher) AS pubs, collect(DISTINCT a.iati_identifier) AS acts,
     reduce(acc = [], l IN collect(DISTINCT p.source_ids) | acc + coalesce(l, [])) + collect(DISTINCT a.source_id) AS ev
WHERE size(pubs) >= $min_publishers
RETURN o.ref AS key, size(acts) AS value, ev AS evidence
ORDER BY key
templates.coverage: Identity is by organisation ref; the same organisation under different refs is not merged (see resolver).

templates.name: top_funders
templates.description: Organisations providing the largest sum of transactions of one type to one publisher's activities, grouped by provider ref and currency. Default type '1' (incoming funds). measure: net (default), amount (positive rows only) or adjustments (negative rows only).
templates.cypher:
MATCH (a:Activity {publisher: $publisher})-[:HAS_TRANSACTION]->(t:Transaction {type: $type_code})<-[pb:PROVIDES]-(o:Organisation)
WHERE ($currency IS NULL OR t.currency = $currency) AND ($measure = 'net' OR ($measure = 'amount' AND t.value > 0) OR ($measure = 'adjustments' AND t.value < 0))
WITH o, t.currency AS currency, sum(t.value_cents) / 100.0 AS total,
     collect(DISTINCT t.source_id) + reduce(acc = [], l IN collect(DISTINCT pb.source_ids) | acc + coalesce(l, [])) + collect(DISTINCT a.source_id) AS ev
RETURN o.ref + ' [' + currency + ']' AS key, total AS value, ev AS evidence
ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT $limit
templates.coverage: Sums exact cents per currency with no conversion; includes the publisher's own rows (unlike Alex's top_funders); a provider published under several refs appears several times.

templates.name: shared_partners
templates.description: Organisation refs that participate in activities of both publisher_a and publisher_b, with the number of distinct activities across the two.
templates.cypher:
MATCH (o:Organisation)-[p:PARTICIPATES_IN]->(a:Activity)
WHERE a.publisher IN [$publisher_a, $publisher_b]
WITH o, collect(DISTINCT a.publisher) AS pubs, collect(DISTINCT a.iati_identifier) AS acts,
     reduce(acc = [], l IN collect(DISTINCT p.source_ids) | acc + coalesce(l, [])) + collect(DISTINCT a.source_id) AS ev
WHERE $publisher_a IN pubs AND $publisher_b IN pubs
RETURN o.ref AS key, size(acts) AS value, ev AS evidence
ORDER BY value DESC, key
templates.coverage: Participation role is ignored; use participants_by_role for role breakdowns.

templates.name: transaction_total
templates.description: Sum of transaction values for one publisher, one transaction type code and one currency, optionally restricted to dates in [date_from, date_to). Returns key 'total'. measure: net (default, signed sum), amount (positive transactions only) or adjustments (negative transactions only, a negative number).
templates.cypher:
OPTIONAL MATCH (a:Activity {publisher: $publisher})-[:HAS_TRANSACTION]->(t:Transaction {type: $type_code, currency: $currency})
WHERE ($date_from IS NULL OR t.date >= date($date_from)) AND ($date_to IS NULL OR t.date < date($date_to)) AND ($measure = 'net' OR ($measure = 'amount' AND t.value > 0) OR ($measure = 'adjustments' AND t.value < 0))
RETURN 'total' AS key, coalesce(sum(t.value_cents), 0) / 100.0 AS value,
       [x IN collect(DISTINCT t.source_id) WHERE x IS NOT NULL] + [x IN collect(DISTINCT a.source_id) WHERE x IS NOT NULL] AS evidence
templates.coverage: One type and one currency only; never mixes commitments, disbursements or currencies.

templates.name: funding_over_time
templates.description: Sum of transaction values per calendar year for one publisher, type code and currency. measure: net (default), amount (positive rows) or adjustments (negative rows).
templates.cypher:
MATCH (a:Activity {publisher: $publisher})-[:HAS_TRANSACTION]->(t:Transaction {type: $type_code, currency: $currency})
WHERE t.date IS NOT NULL AND ($measure = 'net' OR ($measure = 'amount' AND t.value > 0) OR ($measure = 'adjustments' AND t.value < 0))
RETURN toString(t.date.year) AS key, sum(t.value_cents) / 100.0 AS value,
       collect(DISTINCT t.source_id) + collect(DISTINCT a.source_id) AS evidence
ORDER BY key

templates.name: negative_transactions_per_publisher
templates.description: Number of transaction rows with a negative value per publisher (adjustments and reversals, not errors).
templates.cypher:
MATCH (a:Activity)-[:HAS_TRANSACTION]->(t:Transaction)
WHERE t.value < 0
RETURN a.publisher AS key, count(t) AS value, collect(DISTINCT t.source_id) + collect(DISTINCT a.source_id) AS evidence
ORDER BY key
templates.coverage: Only 3% of negatives are exact reversals; most are partial adjustments.

templates.name: count_activities
templates.description: Scalar count of DISTINCT activities matching every given filter (all optional; omit = no filter). Filters: publisher; country_code (ISO-2 targeted); status code ('2' implementation, '3' finalisation = completed); humanitarian ('1'/'0'); default_currency; has_actual_start / has_actual_end / has_planned_start / has_planned_end; has_location; has_sdg; has_sector; has_budget; has_transaction; has_negative_transaction; transaction_type (activity has a transaction of this type code); participant_role and participant_role_2 (activity has an organisation in this role: '1' funding, '2' accountable, '3' extending, '4' implementing); actual_start_before / actual_end_before (YYYY-MM-DD, exclusive); start_from / start_to on start_date. Returns key 'count'. Use for 'how many activities ...' questions combining conditions.
templates.cypher:
MATCH (a:Activity)
WHERE ($publisher IS NULL OR a.publisher = $publisher)
  AND ($status IS NULL OR a.status = $status)
  AND ($humanitarian IS NULL OR a.humanitarian = $humanitarian)
  AND ($default_currency IS NULL OR a.default_currency = $default_currency)
  AND ($has_actual_start IS NULL OR (a.start_actual IS NOT NULL) = $has_actual_start)
  AND ($has_actual_end IS NULL OR (a.end_actual IS NOT NULL) = $has_actual_end)
  AND ($has_planned_start IS NULL OR (a.start_planned IS NOT NULL) = $has_planned_start)
  AND ($has_planned_end IS NULL OR (a.end_planned IS NOT NULL) = $has_planned_end)
  AND ($actual_start_before IS NULL OR a.start_actual < date($actual_start_before))
  AND ($actual_end_before IS NULL OR a.end_actual < date($actual_end_before))
  AND ($start_from IS NULL OR a.start_date >= date($start_from))
  AND ($start_to IS NULL OR a.start_date < date($start_to))
  AND ($country_code IS NULL OR EXISTS { (a)-[:TARGETS]->(:Country {code: $country_code}) })
  AND ($has_location IS NULL OR EXISTS { (a)-[:LOCATED_AT]->(:Location) } = $has_location)
  AND ($has_sdg IS NULL OR EXISTS { (a)-[:CONTRIBUTES_TO]->(:SDG) } = $has_sdg)
  AND ($has_sector IS NULL OR EXISTS { (a)-[:CLASSIFIED_AS]->(:Sector) } = $has_sector)
  AND ($has_budget IS NULL OR EXISTS { (a)-[:HAS_BUDGET]->(:Budget) } = $has_budget)
  AND ($has_transaction IS NULL OR EXISTS { (a)-[:HAS_TRANSACTION]->(:Transaction) } = $has_transaction)
  AND ($has_negative_transaction IS NULL OR EXISTS { (a)-[:HAS_TRANSACTION]->(t:Transaction) WHERE t.value < 0 } = $has_negative_transaction)
  AND ($transaction_type IS NULL OR EXISTS { (a)-[:HAS_TRANSACTION]->(:Transaction {type: $transaction_type}) })
  AND ($participant_role IS NULL OR EXISTS { (:Organisation)-[:PARTICIPATES_IN {role: $participant_role}]->(a) })
  AND ($participant_role_2 IS NULL OR EXISTS { (:Organisation)-[:PARTICIPATES_IN {role: $participant_role_2}]->(a) })
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[r1:TARGETS]->(c1:Country) WHERE $country_code IS NOT NULL AND c1.code = $country_code
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[r2:LOCATED_AT]->(:Location) WHERE $has_location = true
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[r3:CONTRIBUTES_TO]->(:SDG) WHERE $has_sdg = true
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[r4:CLASSIFIED_AS]->(:Sector) WHERE $has_sector = true
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[r5:HAS_BUDGET]->(:Budget) WHERE $has_budget = true
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[r6:HAS_TRANSACTION]->(t6:Transaction)
  WHERE $has_transaction = true OR ($has_negative_transaction = true AND t6.value < 0) OR ($transaction_type IS NOT NULL AND t6.type = $transaction_type)
OPTIONAL MATCH (:Organisation)-[r7:PARTICIPATES_IN]->(a) WHERE r7.role = $participant_role OR r7.role = $participant_role_2
WITH a, reduce(acc = [], l IN collect(DISTINCT r1.source_ids) | acc + coalesce(l, [])) + reduce(acc = [], l IN collect(DISTINCT r2.source_ids) | acc + coalesce(l, [])) + reduce(acc = [], l IN collect(DISTINCT r3.source_ids) | acc + coalesce(l, [])) + reduce(acc = [], l IN collect(DISTINCT r4.source_ids) | acc + coalesce(l, [])) + reduce(acc = [], l IN collect(DISTINCT r5.source_ids) | acc + coalesce(l, [])) + reduce(acc = [], l IN collect(DISTINCT r6.source_ids) | acc + coalesce(l, [])) + reduce(acc = [], l IN collect(DISTINCT r7.source_ids) | acc + coalesce(l, []))
     + [x IN collect(DISTINCT t6.source_id) WHERE x IS NOT NULL] AS ev
WITH count(DISTINCT a) AS n, collect(DISTINCT a.source_id) AS act_ev, reduce(acc = [], l IN collect(ev) | acc + l) AS rel_ev
RETURN 'count' AS key, n AS value, act_ev + rel_ev AS evidence
templates.coverage: Counts distinct retained activities; every filter is AND-ed. Role filters use participation rows, not transaction providers.

templates.name: count_transactions
templates.description: Scalar count of transaction rows (key 'count'), optionally filtered by publisher, type_code, currency, sign ('positive' value > 0, 'negative' value < 0, 'zero' value = 0), country_code of the activity, and dates in [date_from, date_to).
templates.cypher:
MATCH (a:Activity)-[:HAS_TRANSACTION]->(t:Transaction)
WHERE ($publisher IS NULL OR a.publisher = $publisher)
  AND ($type_code IS NULL OR t.type = $type_code)
  AND ($currency IS NULL OR t.currency = $currency)
  AND ($sign IS NULL OR ($sign = 'positive' AND t.value > 0) OR ($sign = 'negative' AND t.value < 0) OR ($sign = 'zero' AND t.value = 0))
  AND ($date_from IS NULL OR t.date >= date($date_from)) AND ($date_to IS NULL OR t.date < date($date_to))
  AND ($country_code IS NULL OR EXISTS { (a)-[:TARGETS]->(:Country {code: $country_code}) })
WITH count(t) AS n, collect(DISTINCT t.source_id) AS tev, collect(DISTINCT a.source_id) AS aev
RETURN 'count' AS key, n AS value, tev + aev AS evidence
templates.coverage: Counts rows, not distinct amounts; zero-value rows count only with sign = 'zero' or no sign filter.

templates.name: count_organisations
templates.description: Scalar count of DISTINCT organisation refs (key 'count'), optionally only those participating in a role ('1' funding ... '4' implementing) and/or in one publisher's activities. No filters = every Organisation node.
templates.cypher:
MATCH (o:Organisation)
WHERE ($participant_role IS NULL AND $publisher IS NULL)
   OR EXISTS { (o)-[p:PARTICIPATES_IN]->(a:Activity) WHERE ($participant_role IS NULL OR p.role = $participant_role) AND ($publisher IS NULL OR a.publisher = $publisher) }
OPTIONAL MATCH (o)-[p:PARTICIPATES_IN]->(a:Activity)
  WHERE ($participant_role IS NOT NULL OR $publisher IS NOT NULL) AND ($participant_role IS NULL OR p.role = $participant_role) AND ($publisher IS NULL OR a.publisher = $publisher)
WITH o, reduce(acc = [], l IN collect(DISTINCT p.source_ids) | acc + coalesce(l, [])) + [x IN collect(DISTINCT a.source_id) WHERE x IS NOT NULL] AS ev
WITH count(DISTINCT o.ref) AS n, collect(DISTINCT o.source_id) AS oev, reduce(acc = [], l IN collect(ev) | acc + l) AS rev
RETURN 'count' AS key, n AS value, oev + rev AS evidence
templates.coverage: Identity is by ref; the same organisation under several refs counts several times (see resolver).

bench.q: How many distinct organisation references are recorded?

templates.name: count_locations
templates.description: Scalar count of DISTINCT named Location nodes (key 'count'), optionally for one publisher or one targeted country.
templates.cypher:
MATCH (a:Activity)-[r:LOCATED_AT]->(l:Location)
WHERE ($publisher IS NULL OR a.publisher = $publisher)
  AND ($country_code IS NULL OR EXISTS { (a)-[:TARGETS]->(:Country {code: $country_code}) })
WITH count(DISTINCT l.location_id) AS n, collect(DISTINCT l.source_id) AS lev, reduce(acc = [], l IN collect(DISTINCT r.source_ids) | acc + coalesce(l, [])) AS rev, collect(DISTINCT a.source_id) AS aev
RETURN 'count' AS key, n AS value, lev + rev + aev AS evidence
templates.coverage: A location row is a publisher-declared place, not necessarily a beneficiary location.

bench.q: How many distinct named locations are recorded?

templates.name: date_extreme
templates.description: Earliest or latest recorded activity date (key 'date', value YYYY-MM-DD). field: start_actual, end_actual, start_planned, end_planned or last_updated; which: 'earliest' or 'latest'. Optional publisher filter. Evidence cites every row considered.
templates.cypher:
MATCH (a:Activity)
WHERE ($publisher IS NULL OR a.publisher = $publisher) AND a[$field] IS NOT NULL
WITH CASE WHEN $which = 'earliest' THEN min(a[$field]) ELSE max(a[$field]) END AS d, collect(DISTINCT a.source_id) AS ev
RETURN 'date' AS key, left(toString(d), 10) AS value, ev AS evidence
templates.coverage: Dates are the publisher's recorded values; planned and actual fields are distinct.

templates.name: budget_total

RETURN 'total' AS key, coalesce(sum(b.value_cents), 0) / 100.0 AS value, [x IN collect(DISTINCT b.source_id) WHERE x IS NOT NULL] AS evidence

answer.question: What is the net sum of WFP incoming funds in USD dated in calendar year 2020?
answer.cypher:
OPTIONAL MATCH (a:Activity {publisher: $publisher})-[:HAS_TRANSACTION]->(t:Transaction {type: $type_code, currency: $currency})
WHERE ($date_from IS NULL OR t.date >= date($date_from)) AND ($date_to IS NULL OR t.date < date($date_to)) AND ($measure = 'net' OR ($measure = 'amount' AND t.value > 0) OR ($measure = 'adjustments' AND t.value < 0))
RETURN 'total' AS key, coalesce(sum(t.value_cents), 0) / 100.0 AS value,
       [x IN collect(DISTINCT t.source_id) WHERE x IS NOT NULL] + [x IN collect(DISTINCT a.source_id) WHERE x IS NOT NULL] AS evidence

answer.cypher:
MATCH (a:Activity)
WHERE ($publisher IS NULL OR a.publisher = $publisher)
  AND ($status IS NULL OR a.status = $status)
  AND ($humanitarian IS NULL OR a.humanitarian = $humanitarian)
  AND ($default_currency IS NULL OR a.default_currency = $default_currency)
  AND ($has_actual_start IS NULL OR (a.start_actual IS NOT NULL) = $has_actual_start)
  AND ($has_actual_end IS NULL OR (a.end_actual IS NOT NULL) = $has_actual_end)
  AND ($has_planned_start IS NULL OR (a.start_planned IS NOT NULL) = $has_planned_start)
  AND ($has_planned_end IS NULL OR (a.end_planned IS NOT NULL) = $has_planned_end)
  AND ($actual_start_before IS NULL OR a.start_actual < date($actual_start_before))
  AND ($actual_end_before IS NULL OR a.end_actual < date($actual_end_before))
  AND ($start_from IS NULL OR a.start_date >= date($start_from))
  AND ($start_to IS NULL OR a.start_date < date($start_to))
  AND ($country_code IS NULL OR EXISTS { (a)-[:TARGETS]->(:Country {code: $country_code}) })
  AND ($has_location IS NULL OR EXISTS { (a)-[:LOCATED_AT]->(:Location) } = $has_location)
  AND ($has_sdg IS NULL OR EXISTS { (a)-[:CONTRIBUTES_TO]->(:SDG) } = $has_sdg)
  AND ($has_sector IS NULL OR EXISTS { (a)-[:CLASSIFIED_AS]->(:Sector) } = $has_sector)
  AND ($has_budget IS NULL OR EXISTS { (a)-[:HAS_BUDGET]->(:Budget) } = $has_budget)
  AND ($has_transaction IS NULL OR EXISTS { (a)-[:HAS_TRANSACTION]->(:Transaction) } = $has_transaction)
  AND ($has_negative_transaction IS NULL OR EXISTS { (a)-[:HAS_TRANSACTION]->(t:Transaction) WHERE t.value < 0 } = $has_negative_transaction)
  AND ($transaction_type IS NULL OR EXISTS { (a)-[:HAS_TRANSACTION]->(:Transaction {type: $transaction_type}) })
  AND ($participant_role IS NULL OR EXISTS { (:Organisation)-[:PARTICIPATES_IN {role: $participant_role}]->(a) })
  AND ($participant_role_2 IS NULL OR EXISTS { (:Organisation)-[:PARTICIPATES_IN {role: $participant_role_2}]->(a) })
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[r1:TARGETS]->(c1:Country) WHERE $country_code IS NOT NULL AND c1.code = $country_code
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[r2:LOCATED_AT]->(:Location) WHERE $has_location = true
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[r3:CONTRIBUTES_TO]->(:SDG) WHERE $has_sdg = true
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[r4:CLASSIFIED_AS]->(:Sector) WHERE $has_sector = true
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[r5:HAS_BUDGET]->(:Budget) WHERE $has_budget = true
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[r6:HAS_TRANSACTION]->(t6:Transaction)
  WHERE $has_transaction = true OR ($has_negative_transaction = true AND t6.value < 0) OR ($transaction_type IS NOT NULL AND t6.type = $transaction_type)
OPTIONAL MATCH (:Organisation)-[r7:PARTICIPATES_IN]->(a) WHERE r7.role = $participant_role OR r7.role = $participant_role_2
WITH a, reduce(acc = [], l IN collect(DISTINCT r1.source_ids) | acc + coalesce(l, [])) + reduce(acc = [], l IN collect(DISTINCT r2.source_ids) | acc + coalesce(l, [])) + reduce(acc = [], l IN collect(DISTINCT r3.source_ids) | acc + coalesce(l, [])) + reduce(acc = [], l IN collect(DISTINCT r4.source_ids) | acc + coalesce(l, [])) + reduce(acc = [], l IN collect(DISTINCT r5.source_ids) | acc + coalesce(l, [])) + reduce(acc = [], l IN collect(DISTINCT r6.source_ids) | acc + coalesce(l, [])) + reduce(acc = [], l IN collect(DISTINCT r7.source_ids) | acc + coalesce(l, []))
     + [x IN collect(DISTINCT t6.source_id) WHERE x IS NOT NULL] AS ev
WITH count(DISTINCT a) AS n, collect(DISTINCT a.source_id) AS act_ev, reduce(acc = [], l IN collect(ev) | acc + l) AS rel_ev
RETURN 'count' AS key, n AS value, act_ev + rel_ev AS evidence
